facts.value: The split target is eight bytes: f32 zero at offset 0 and one at offset 4, with ALLOC flags. The existing source object instead has a 24-byte WRITE|ALLOC section: eight zero bytes, f32 zero/one at offsets 8/12, then eight zero bytes. Runtime protection and a source/split section match are not established.
facts.rationale: The split section is 8 bytes while the source section is 24 bytes; write flags also differ. Record the target layout separately from the observed source object.

evidence.why: The split section is 8 bytes while the source section is 24 bytes; write flags also differ. Record the target layout separately from the observed source object.

facts.value: Provides zero and one literals for common down-tilt entry at frame zero, speed one and zero blend. This is a compiler-emitted literal pool, not a standalone gameplay table; local code reads it without writing.
facts.rationale: Read usage does not establish read-only ELF flags or runtime protection.

evidence.why: Read usage does not establish read-only ELF flags or runtime protection.

facts.value: Maintains grounded sliding and deceleration during down tilt according to character ground friction. When absolute ground velocity exceeds maximum walk speed, friction is multiplied by common friction_when_above_walk_speed before ground movement.
facts.rationale: The callee proves multiplication above walking speed, not that the runtime multiplier must always strengthen deceleration.

evidence.why: The callee proves multiplication above walking speed, not that the runtime multiplier must always strengthen deceleration.
